title: Scripture and False Teaching
definition: Scripture and false teaching are opposed because God's Word reveals truth and exposes teaching that distorts Christ, the Gospel, or godliness.
summary: God's Word protects the Church from teaching that leads people away from Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the truth, and false teaching is dangerous because it distorts His person, His Gospel, or His commands.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
False teaching is not merely a different opinion. Scripture warns that some teaching distorts the Gospel, denies truth, excuses sin, or leads people away from Christ.

The Church must test teaching by Scripture. Popularity, emotion, spiritual language, or impressive personality cannot replace faithfulness to God's Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: False teaching can damage souls and churches while appearing helpful or inspiring. This doctrine matters because God's people need protection rooted in truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Test messages, teachers, and movements by Scripture. Reject what distorts Christ or the Gospel, and hold fast to sound doctrine with humility and love.
